evals.name: csv-export-default-spec-dir
evals.prompt: requirements.md and design.md for the csv-export feature are approved in .kiro/specs/csv-export/. Generate the implementation plan for the Kiro IDE agent to execute task by task. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, state your assumption in the output and in your final message, and finish.
evals.expected_output: The skill defines tasks.md exactly: numbered checkboxes, two levels, 2-space indents, `_Requirements: X.Y_` on every task, coding tasks only, foundation -> core -> polish, each small enough for one LLM pass, written to the spec dir; an unguided plan usually includes testing/deploy/doc steps, mixes formats, or leaves criteria unreferenced.
expectations: tasks.md written in the spec dir
Numbered checkboxes, max 2 levels, every leaf has _Requirements:_, all 9 criteria referenced
Kiro format: `- [ ] N.` top-level and `- [ ] N.M` sub-tasks indented 2 spaces, max two levels, each task with detail bullets and an italic `_Requirements: X.Y_` line: Every task follows the format
Traceability: all nine criteria (1.1-4.2) map to at least one task and references are accurate to what the task implements: All nine mapped accurately
Ordering and size: foundation (structure, interfaces) then core then polish (errors, edge cases); each task is one coherent code change with its tests: Clear incremental order and LLM-sized tasks
Only coding tasks: no deploy, Terraform/infra rollout, documentation, UAT or pilot steps; no invented requirements or IDs: None present

scripted_checks.text: tasks.md written in the spec dir
Numbered checkboxes, max 2 levels, every leaf has _Requirements:_, all 9 criteria referenced
scripted_checks.check: python3 -c 'import re,sys;L=open(".kiro/specs/csv-export/tasks.md").read().splitlines();T=[(i,len(l)-len(l.lstrip()),m.group(1)) for i,l in enumerate(L) for m in [re.match(r"\s*- \[[ x-]\] (\d+(?:\.\d+)*)\.?\s",l)] if m];ok=len(T)>=3 and all(t[2].count(".")<=1 for t in T);nxt=[T[k+1][0] if k+1<len(T) else len(L) for k in range(len(T))];leaf=[k for k in range(len(T)) if k+1==len(T) or T[k+1][1]<=T[k][1]];ok=ok and all(any("_Requirements:" in x for x in L[T[k][0]:nxt[k]]) for k in leaf);txt=chr(10).join(x for x in L if "_Requirements" in x);ok=ok and all(re.search(r"(?<![0-9.])"+re.escape(r)+r"(?![0-9])",txt) for r in ["1.1", "1.2", "1.3", "2.1", "2.2", "3.1", "3.2", "4.1", "4.2"]);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'

evals.name: auth-refresh-custom-spec-dir
evals.prompt: Our specs do not live in the default location: requirements and design for auth-refresh are in docs/specs/auth-refresh/. Write the tasks file for it, next to the other two. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, state your assumption in the output and in your final message, and finish.
evals.expected_output: The skill takes a caller-supplied spec_dir and makes writing tasks.md anywhere else a CRITICAL failure; it also requires every criterion to be referenced, including the race criterion 2.3 that the design solves with a conditional UPDATE ... RETURNING. Without the skill, outputs land under .kiro/specs/ by habit or fold the race into a generic task.
expectations: tasks.md in docs/specs/auth-refresh/ and nothing under .kiro/specs/auth-refresh
Leaf tasks reference requirements; all 6 criteria covered; max 2 levels
Kiro format: `- [ ] N.` top-level and `- [ ] N.M` sub-tasks indented 2 spaces, max two levels, each task with detail bullets and an italic `_Requirements: X.Y_` line: Every task follows the format

A dedicated task implements the refresh-token race (2.3) with the design's conditional `UPDATE ... WHERE revoked_at IS NULL RETURNING id` and a concurrency test; reuse detection revokes the whole family (2.2): Both as explicit tasks with tests

Client-side criteria (1.1-1.3: refresh at <60s, single retry, clear session on 401) and server criteria are ordered sensibly (server rotation before client retry logic): Sensible order with both sides covered
Only coding tasks: no deploy, Terraform/infra rollout, documentation, UAT or pilot steps; no invented requirements or IDs: None present

scripted_checks.text: tasks.md in docs/specs/auth-refresh/ and nothing under .kiro/specs/auth-refresh
Leaf tasks reference requirements; all 6 criteria covered; max 2 levels
